5042.label: Arc Mainnet
5042.note: Arc APS is unavailable (roadmap only); USDC gas and account balances are public.

fact_notice: Fact attestations carry no direct payment identifiers. The issuer can link issuance to the originating check; repeated presentations of the same fact are linkable.

pool_warnings.exact_amount_linkage: An exact-amount deposit/withdrawal pair is linkable evidence, not proof of a unique owner.
pool_warnings.gpl_verifier: The snarkjs-generated TransactVerifier is GPL-3.0; distribution needs license review. No Tacit code is bundled.
pool_warnings.immutable_no_pause: The reviewed pool is immutable with no pause/admin; a discovered circuit bug cannot be paused.
pool_warnings.no_human_audit: No independent human audit identified for TacitEvmPool/transact.circom; V1 AI reviews cover different code.
pool_warnings.post_sweep_destruction: EIP-6780: a receive box created and self-destructed during its sweep transaction is deleted at transaction end. Later ETH sent to it in that same transaction can be destroyed. Never schedule post-sweep payments.
pool_warnings.public_boundaries: Deposit sender and amount, withdrawal recipient and amount, timing and gas are public.
pool_warnings.receive_box_reuse: Receive boxes are reused standing addresses; payments into one box are publicly linked.
pool_warnings.relay_dependency: Keeper/relayer availability and metadata are dependencies; their current state is unknown.
pool_warnings.small_set: Small/young sets are a risk. Counts and tree slots do not establish independent users or eligible unspent notes.
pool_warnings.unvalidated_ceremony: Groth16 ceremony is vendor-claimed and unvalidated; setup or circuit failure can lose all funds.

instructions: Generate a new wallet locally; keep all keys on device.
Use it once; avoid linked gas funding, address reuse and consolidation.

warnings: Gas funding from linked wallets reveals the recipient.
The announce caller is public: use the payer or an unlinked account; the registrant or a recipient-linked caller reveals the recipient.
Never reuse a derived address, including across invoices.
Sweeps and consolidation can link receipts; review separately.
Keep invoice metadata off-chain and encrypted; only a view tag is planned on-chain.
RPC providers can correlate IP and queries; registration is public.
Token issuers retain freeze powers; screening is unknown.
Keys and reuse history are volatile; durable local recovery is not implemented.
Registration is deferred: third-party payments to a registered volatile meta-address after a restart would be permanently unrecoverable.
Do not fund until recovery, live contract checks and local signer review are complete.
